sources.text: Possibly the same producer as Carlow Sheep Cheddar (Carlow Farmhouse Cheese, Fennagh); milk and type unverified

facts.v: Hand-made from pasteurised cow's milk bought from a neighbouring farmer, per the producer's page; Edam-style washed curd, some flavoured
Made since 2005 by Elizabeth Bradley at Carlow Farmhouse Cheese, Ballybrommell, Fennagh, Co. Carlow
